status: original playable-content design; schema-neutral; not yet connected to the existing engine
license_note: Original game concept and original card text supplied for this project. Art prompts describe original artwork; no external artwork included.
import_note: Canonical content proposal, NOT the repository importer schema. Implement a reviewed adapter to the actual engine types. The effect opcodes below are design-level DSL and may require handlers. Do not parse summaries as code.

rules.workshop_phase: Play Action cards using Actions available; Device cards are played as Actions and their delayed effects resolve at next turn start. May end phase manually.
rules.market_phase: Play individual Currency cards for Coins; spend up to 2 Spark during this phase, each for +1 Coin. Buy cards from market or basic supply. A Public Work claim uses one Buy, its listed Coins, and its listed Spark; each Public Work may be claimed once per game. Unspent Coins expire at cleanup. No forced transitions.
rules.spark: Persistent player token, cap 8. Gain effects exceeding cap are lost. Market-phase conversion limited to 2 Spark total per turn. Spending Spark for Public Works is independent of conversion. End-game Spark may affect scoring.
rules.market_setup: Randomly choose 10 distinct market designs from the 36; each gets 10 copies for 2–4 players or 12 for 5–6. Select 5 distinct Public Works from the 8 at random, each claimable once; offer manual selection and shareable configuration.
rules.basic_supply: Scrap, Cog, Dynamo; Notebook, Blueprint, Monument. Quantity for prestige piles: 8 (2 players), 12 (3–4), 15 (5), 18 (6); currency piles should be generously provisioned and never empty in regular games.
rules.end_condition: At end of current active player turn: Monument pile empty OR 3 market piles empty OR 4 of 5 Public Works claimed. For 5–6 players: 4 market piles instead of 3. Winner has highest combined card Prestige plus Public Work Prestige; ties resolved by fewer turns, then shared victory.
rules.triggers: Resolve next-turn effects before workshop phase, in owner-chosen order when necessary. Device cards remain in play until delayed effect is complete and then discard at cleanup. Resolve all optional decisions with server-authoritative choices.
rules.reshuffle: When a draw is required and deck is insufficient, shuffle discard into draw deck using seeded RNG; do not shuffle cards held in hand or in-play devices.
rules.player_visibility: Hands and draw order private; hand counts, deck counts, discard tops, Supply and Public Works public.
rules.undo: Only allowed when no new hidden information was exposed, no irreversible inter-player commitment occurred, and engine declares action reversible.
